notable_absence.finding: The page's JSON example task objects (type: MERGE, BACKUP, PRUNE) are the clearest on-page evidence in this whole batch that a 'task' is a shared runtime concept spanning backup, merge, and prune operations - yet the page never links backup-trigger-merge.md or backup-trigger-prune.md (this same batch), only backup-create-and-edit-plans.md. The task-type taxonomy is demonstrated in data but not cross-referenced in prose.

cross_component_finding: Confirms round 19's finding that a repository's status (active/archived/imported) is a first-class, queryable state, not an incidental label: this endpoint's REPO_STATUS path parameter takes the identical three-way enum used elsewhere in this batch (backup-import-repository.md's repository-specification, backup-restore-data.md's restore path). A task's history persists and remains readable after a repository is archived or imported, per the enum covering all three - direct evidence that archiving/importing a repository is a status change on the SAME object, not a migration to a different kind of thing.
